_doc: Phase 019: the founding population's implied history. Drawn per founder on its own stream (map seed + `stream`), after the cast and households, so no existing draw moves. Every value is a model parameter. The citations are from memory and were not checked against the texts; each is marked APPROX. `apprenticeship_term_years`: the Statute of Artificers 1563 (5 Eliz. c.4) set a seven-year term for many trades (from memory). `level_per_year` is a model choice: a trade skill gained by apprenticeship is min(trade base skill, level_per_year x years).
